ARTBOARD 01 · PUBLIC LANDING PAGE & CLINICAL TELEMETRY

AI assists. Doctors decide.
Patients stay in control.

A unified clinical architecture prototype engineered for Bangladesh. Streamlining
fragmented diagnostic lab reports, cryptographic prescription verification,
and real-time doctor chamber telehealth queues across 64 districts.
Converts paper lab reports from Popular, Square & Ibn Sina into interactive multi-year trends.
Tamper-evident prescriptions with cryptographic HMAC signatures to prevent reuse & forgery.
Real-time queue tracking, live serial number countdowns, and WebRTC encrypted video consults.
Instant life support (CPR, Snakebite, Burns) and Emergency Medical ID QR without internet.

ARTBOARD 05 · 100% OFFLINE EMERGENCY FIRST-AID HUB & MEDICAL ID (/emergency)
Available 24/7 without internet connection · Tap any hotline to trigger immediate dialer
Paramedic Responders Can Scan This Offline QR Without Login
Instant life support instructions verified by emergency physicians
Ratio: 30 Compressions : 2 Rescue Breaths · Rate: 100-120 bpm

1. Check response & breathing. Shout for help / Call 999.
2. Place heel of hand on center of chest. Push hard and fast at least 2 inches deep.
3. Continue until patient breathes normally or paramedic arrives.
CRITICAL: DO NOT CUT OR SUCK THE WOUND · DO NOT USE TOURNIQUET

1. Keep victim completely calm and immobile to delay venom spread.
2. Apply broad pressure bandage over bite site and along the limb.
3. Transport immediately to nearest Upazila Health Complex with antivenom.
Rule: Cool with clean running water for 20 minutes · No ice or toothpaste

1. Remove jewelry or loose clothing near the burn area before swelling.
2. Cover loosely with sterile plastic cling film or clean dry cloth.
3. Seek urgent hospital burn unit transfer if face, hands or groin are affected.
F: Face Drooping · A: Arm Weakness · S: Slurred Speech · T: Time to 999

1. Note exact time symptoms began (critical for thrombolysis window < 4.5 hrs).
2. Keep patient lying down with head slightly elevated.
3. Do not give any food, water, or aspirin until CT scan is completed.
ARTBOARD 06 · DUAL-GATE CLINICAL TRIAGE & SMARTCARE NAVIGATOR (/navigator)
Describe your symptoms in natural language (বাংলা বা ইংরেজি)

"আমার বুকে প্রচণ্ড চাপ অনুভব হচ্ছে এবং ব্যথা বাঁ হাতে ছড়িয়ে পড়ছে।
শ্বাস নিতে কষ্ট হচ্ছে এবং প্রচুর ঘাম হচ্ছে।"
(Severe crushing chest pain radiating to left arm with diaphoresis)
>> SUSPECTED ACUTE CORONARY SYNDROME / MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION
> PRE-EMPTING LLM GENERATION TO AVOID DELAY
Please call 999 or proceed to nearest hospital emergency room immediately.

The symptoms described (crushing chest discomfort radiating to the left arm accompanied by shortness of breath and sweating) are hallmark signs of Acute Coronary Syndrome (Heart Attack). Every minute is crucial for myocardial preservation.
1. Sit or recline in a comfortable position (45-degree angle). Stop all physical movement.
2. If non-allergic and advised by doctor: Chew 300 mg soluble Aspirin immediately.
3. Keep clothes loose around neck and chest to assist ventilation.
4. Do NOT drive yourself. Wait for ambulance or emergency transport.
